notes:
{交際|こうさい} covers both general social relationships and romantic dating, depending on context.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {交際|こうさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

SENSE 1 — SOCIALIZING:
Refers to maintaining relationships with others in a social or professional context.
- {交際|こうさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧: to have a wide social circle
- {交際|こうさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧: to have a narrow social circle
- {交際|こうさい}⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧: entertainment/socializing expenses

SENSE 2 — DATING:
Refers to a romantic relationship. This is the more common meaning in everyday conversation.
- {交際|こうさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to date, to go out with
- {交際|こうさい}⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧: romantic partner
- {交際|こうさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}む→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧: to ask someone out
- {交際|こうさい}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: length of relationship

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal. In casual speech, ⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}う→付き合う：02291_tsukiau⟧ is more common for "dating." {交際|こうさい} is preferred in news, formal announcements, and written contexts.
